# Markdown

The name of the document ends with .qmd which stands for quarto markdown document. As such, anything that can be done in markdown can also be done in quarto.

**This is bold**

-   first element of a list
-   second element of a list

# Latex

## Inline

One can also insert inline math latex code within the markdown text. For instance, the equation $y = x^2$ is a parabola.

## Display

One can also use latex display mode as follows:

$$
\begin{align}
A &= \frac{\pi r^2}{2} \\
  & \frac{1}{2} \pi r^2,
\end{align}
$$
